title: Loyalty
summary: Find the point where standing by someone stops.
intro: Each situation puts someone you care about against honesty or justice. The interesting part isn't any single answer — it's where your loyalty ends.

questions.prompt: Your brother hit a parked car and drove off. He asks you to tell police he was with you all night.

options.label: Refuse to lie, but don't volunteer anything
Push him to come forward himself

questions.prompt: You learn your child has been bullying a classmate. The other parents call you.

options.label: Handle it at home without admitting it
Admit it and have my child apologize

questions.prompt: Your best friend has been taking about $2,000 from the small business they work for.

options.label: Confront them privately and insist they pay it back

questions.prompt: Your mother asks you to store boxes of records she's hiding from a tax investigation.

options.label: Refuse, but keep it to myself

questions.prompt: A coworker you barely know has been taking about $2,000 from your employer.
Your sibling asks you to cover for them. What's the most serious thing you'd cover?
questions.noneLabel: I wouldn't cover for any of these

options.label: A speeding ticket they're hiding from their spouse
Driving drunk — no one was hurt
